name: Familiarity Stability Control

duplicate_detection.overlap_reason: Both fields target safe continual adaptation, BRONZE/self-label poisoning, open-set health, provenance-gated promotion and rollback for FRANK adaptive state, especially Retina/Unified Memory.
duplicate_detection.resolution: Preserve experiment/findings as correlated replication material, do not register as a separate emergent field, resample to EF-20260809-002-REENTRY-CAUSAL-IDENTIFIABILITY.

primary_hypothesis: A frozen visual backbone plus prototype/linear readout should use evidence-tier admission and open-set feedback; BRONZE self-predictions should not directly rewrite trusted learner state because positive feedback can degrade unknown rejection and later known-class performance under OOD contamination.
